Stage 6 — CRN Cleaning

Module Lookup (Semester-aware)

CRNs are semester-specific identifiers. A CRN used in Semester 1 can be reused in Semester 2 or 3 for a different module — so a CRN from one semester must never be assumed to identify the same module in another semester. Use the search below to find the CRN-to-use for the selected term. If no CRN is available, the module may need to be created. The most reliable way to trigger a new CRN is to attach a lecturer to the module in Brightspace; Banner will then create the module for that semester and issue a new CRN. CRNs do not move between semesters — if a module moves, a new CRN must be created.
